fusions.name: Darting Shoal
fusions.desc: Snaps 5 tails out in a fan to 7 tiles; each deals 6 damage and knocks the enemy it hits back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Slick Crack
fusions.desc: A wet lash at an enemy up to 6 tiles away deals 4 damage. It hits harder the further it travels, up to 1.4 times its damage at maximum range. Its reach is 30% longer, and it has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: You whip yourself 2 tiles clear, then move 30% faster with +10% dodge chance for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Silver Coil
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal +6% damage per stack (+30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
